# Golden rows and frozen files that record the retired implicit-effects
# language (see legacy_language_census_test.go). This is a worklist, not a
# set of approved lowerings: retiring the mapper's form resolver rewrites
# each row in the current language and deletes its line. TestLegacyLanguageCensus
# derives the rows from projectionCases, emitCases and the frozen
# directories and fails when one is not listed here; a line is table, rules,
# row name, separated by tabs. A line whose row was rewritten is logged, and
# UPDATE_LEGACY_CENSUS=1 drops it. New rows are written with `effect` and
# `try`. Tests that write their sources inline
# (the form resolver's, the purity split's and the contract adapters') are
# outside the census and are rewritten with the resolver.
emit	implicit-effect	a function in value position is the Effect wrapper (L2)
emit	sync-value	library data call stays lazy plain TypeScript
projection	catch-value	catch expression defers a value fallback (D236)
projection	catch-value	catch expression retains this in both operands
projection	catch-value	catch expression statement guards ASI
projection	catch-value	catch expression stays in its conditional branch (D237)
projection	catch-value	catch expressions associate to the left (D237)
projection	catch-value	catch in a pipe body captures its topic (D237)
projection	catch-value	nullish coalescing stays inside the catch (D237)
projection	implicit-effect,layer-declaration	a layer with statements builds in an Effect
projection	layer-declaration	a layer without statements succeeds with its members
projection	mutable-member	an error with a class's members keeps them, its fields declared (D278)
projection	mutable-member	members keep TypeScript's mutability, and mutable goes
projection	mutable-member	schema primitives optional literals arrays and readonly
